jobs.title: Senior Copywriter
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team! WHAT TO EXPECT: We re looking for a sharp, versatile Senior Copywriter to own copy across some of Phiture s biggest accounts, including one of Europe’s biggest mobile gaming companies, the USA’s largest retailer, a fintech that keeps families connected across borders, and a fast-growing productivity app. You ll join a close-knit creative pod, working side by side with our Creative Lead, designers and Growth Consultants. Together, you ll turn briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into conversion-focused copy that reaches millions of users in app stores around the world. This isn t copywriting in a vacuum. You ll see how your messaging performs, learn from every test and use those insights to make the next round sharper. You ll switch between very different brands, tones and formats, often within tight character limits and on deadlines tied to larger experiments. It s a role for a writer who cares as much about why copy works as how it sounds, and who wants to grow into ASO, experimentation and creative strategy. WHAT YOU LL DO: Own copy delivery across your assigned accounts, from brief interpretation through to final QA on production and market localisation Translate creative briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into clear, conversion-focused copy, and ask the right questions when context or objectives are missing Write across a range of formats, including: App store metadata, screenshot captions and in-app events Promotional content, storyboards and CRM campaigns Build deep knowledge of each client s brand, products, features and audiences, understanding not just what we re promoting, but why Switch confidently between distinct brand voices, formats and markets, keeping each brand s identity intac

Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you re a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem. Senior Medical Writer  Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role. Our Senior Medical Writers are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members. This role is based in the UK and employed under a UK contract of employment, with contractual working hours of 40 hours per week, but works as part of teams supporting US business and clients. jobs.description: Notre équipe BCP (Business Capabilities Platform) recherche un·e Engineering Manager (f/m/d) en CDI , basé·e à Lille - Upline . Qui sommes-nous ? L équipe Content est au cœur de la stratégie d expérience globale de Decathlon. Notre mission est de propulser et de diffuser l ensemble des contenus de l écosystème : de la gestion des médias à l internationalisation des traductions, en passant par la valorisation des avis utilisateurs. Nous gérons des plateformes à très haute échelle, connectées mondialement, avec pour ambition de transformer la manière dont nos utilisateurs consomment et interagissent avec l information produit. Un terrain de jeu technologique et fonctionnel passionnant, multiculturel et à fort impact ! TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION En tant qu Engineering Manager, tu seras le pilier humain et technique d une équipe de 13 ingénieur·es (développeur·ses, QA, support), composée de profils internes et de partenaires externes. Ton rôle combinera le leadership de personnes, le cadrage de domaines fonctionnels variés et la gouvernance technologique. Management & Accompagnement : Tu animes, coaches et fais grandir une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Tu insuffles une culture de collaboration, d amélioration continue et d excellence d ingénierie, tout en gérant la relation avec nos partenaires externes. Stratégie Produit & Déploiement : Tu pilotes le déploiement à l échelle de onecontent comme produit de diffusion unique des contenus de Decathlon, avant de mener la redéfinition globale de notre stratégie de plateforme. Innovation & IA : Tu orchestres la construction et le déploiement de Onetranslate , notre moteur de traduction de pointe piloté par l Intelligence Artificielle. Expérience Utilisateur : Tu supervises le déploiement du nouveau moteur de modération des avis clients, incluant la gestion et la valorisation des avis photos. Gouvernance Technique : Sans être nécessairement 100% les mains dans le code au quotidien, tu es le garant de la cohérence technique
